core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Rahimaa corresponds to the Arabic form رَحِيمَة (Arabic root ر ح م (r-ḥ-m); رَحِيمَة (Raḥīma)). Its core sense is rahimaa; merciful, compassionate (feminine). Rahimaa is a spelling variant of Arabic رَحِيمَة (Raḥīma) 'merciful, compassionate' (feminine), from the root ر ح م (r-ḥ-m). The source gloss 'Merciful One' is broadly consistent. Same name as rahima.
